comparison.objective: Screen ceramic media from washers vs crimp a board lid onto a foil pan.
comparison.physical_skill: Orientation-dependent rigid-particle passage through holes vs progressive deformation of a soft rim while stabilizing the lid and pan.
comparison.success_condition: Recovered mass and retained parts without spill vs specified fractions of rim folded flat, lid seated, pan undamaged, and hands clear.
comparison.reason: The record tests controlled deformation; the candidate tests rigid granular flow and selective retention.
